The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} is used to cut [[log]]s into usable pieces.  In order to be available for crafting in the {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}, logs must be placed in a [[timber stockpile]].

Horizontal and vertical : 5 X 4

Rotation : No
